_comment: Hermes chat server egg. Import in Admin -> Nests -> Import Egg.
name: Hermes
author: hermes@senko.tools
description: Self-hosted chat with spaces, text and voice channels, DMs and calls. Uses the allocated port for both TCP (HTTPS/WebSocket) and UDP (voice). The console shows the owner invite link on the first start.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Hermes egg installer: downloads the static server binary from the GitHub release.
set -e
cd /mnt/server
case "$(uname -m)" in
  aarch64|arm64) ARCH=aarch64 ;;
  *) ARCH=x86_64 ;;
esac
FILE="hermes-server-${ARCH}-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz"
if [ -z "${VERSION}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
  URL="https://github.com/senko-tools/hermes/releases/latest/download/${FILE}"
else
  URL="https://github.com/senko-tools/hermes/releases/download/${VERSION}/${FILE}"
fi
echo "Downloading ${URL}"
curl -fsSL "${URL}" -o hermes.tar.gz
tar -xzf hermes.tar.gz
rm -f hermes.tar.gz
chmod +x hermes-server
mkdir -p data
[ -f hermes.toml ] || ./hermes-server init --config ./hermes.toml
echo "Hermes installed: $(./hermes-server version)"

variables.name: Version
variables.description: Release tag to install (e.g. v1.0.0) or 'latest'. Reinstall the server to update; the database and config are kept.

variables.name: Public host
variables.description: Domain or public IP that friends connect to (used in invite links). Without a port: the allocated port is added.

variables.name: Data directory
variables.description: Where the database and uploads live (inside the server folder).

variables.name: Log format
variables.description: Plain text lines work best in the panel console.
